name: Drumline
overview: A talented street drummer from Harlem enrolls in a Southern university, expecting to lead its marching band's drumline to victory. He initially flounders in his new world, before realizing that it takes more than talent to reach the top.

name: Drumline: A New Beat
overview: A girl from New York attends a college in Atlanta to join their once-famous marching band.

name: UFSCar Drumline
overview: The flooding that occurred in the UFSCar small drum room on February 8, 2026 --- the very day a Carnival performance at Pholia had been scheduled.

name: Kaotic Drumline: Drumming With a Difference
overview: On the South Side of Chicago, the Kaotic Drumline brings people together with creativity, energy and hope. [Documentary Short] . . . Conceived as a follow-up to the critically-acclaimed documentary "Tomorrow's Hope" (https://tomorrowshopefilm.com).
